fullTextZH: 今天我要给你讲一个故事
fullTextEN: Today I want to tell you a story.
I am not an old man.

fullTextZH: 他住在一个国家的旁边
fullTextEN: He lived next to a country.

fullTextZH: 不是在一个国家的中间
fullTextEN: Not in the middle of a country,
These horses were very, very good.

fullTextZH: 所以这个老人非常开心
fullTextEN: So this old man was very happy.

fullTextZH: 邻居就是住在他旁边的人
fullTextEN: A neighbor is someone who lives next to him.
This might be a good thing.

fullTextZH: 这怎么会是一件好事呢
fullTextEN: How could this be a good thing?
But it might be a good thing
Suddenly, the horse that ran away

fullTextZH: 带回来很多很多别的马
fullTextEN: brought back many, many other horses

fullTextZH: 所以现在老人有更多更多的马了
fullTextEN: So now the old man has more and more horses

fullTextZH: 太好了现在你有很多很多马
fullTextEN: Great, now you have many, many horses
This might be a bad thing
He said you have so many horses
How could it be a bad thing?
It might be a bad thing.

fullTextZH: 他的儿子在骑马的时候
fullTextEN: When his son was riding a horse.

fullTextZH: 现在他的儿子不能走路啦
所以老人的邻居和他说
fullTextEN: So the old man's neighbor said to him.
This might be a good thing.

fullTextZH: 为什么你的儿子现在不能走路了
fullTextEN: Why can't your son walk now?
Maybe this is a good thing

fullTextZH: 所以所有的年轻人都要去打仗
fullTextEN: So all the young people had to go to war
Staying at home is very safe
It might also be a good thing

fullTextZH: 在中国这个故事非常有名
fullTextEN: This story is very famous in China
This story is called 'Sai Weng Lost His Horse'
It tells us good things and bad things.
Good things might turn into bad things.
Bad things might also turn into good things.
I hope you like this story.
